why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Nick Madrigal is slot #9 (4.172 expected team runs/game).
Slots #9, #8, #7, #5, #6, #4, #3, #1, #2 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #9 yields 3.72 expected PA/game vs 3.96 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.

Cleanup (#4) models -0.001 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
